1.web: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
1.asv: Give ear, ye heavens, and I will speak; And let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

2.web: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
2.asv: My doctrine shall drop as the rain; My speech shall distil as the dew, As the small rain upon the tender grass, And as the showers upon the herb.

3.web: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
3.asv: For I will proclaim the name of Jehovah: Ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

4.web: The Rock, his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
4.asv: The Rock, his work is perfect; For all his ways are justice: A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, Just and right is he.

5.web: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
5.asv: They have dealt corruptly with him, they are not his children, it is their blemish; They area perverse and crooked generation.

6.web: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
6.asv: Do ye thus requite Jehovah, O foolish people and unwise? Is not he thy father that hath bought thee? He hath made thee, and established thee.

7.web: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
7.asv: Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations: Ask thy father, and he will show thee; Thine elders, and they will tell thee.

8.web: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
8.asv: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, When he separated the children of men, He set the bounds of the peoples According to the number of the children of Israel.

9.web: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
9.asv: For Jehovah’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

10.web: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
10.asv: He found him in a desert land, And in the waste howling wilderness; He compassed him about, he cared for him, He kept him as the apple of his eye.

11.web: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
11.asv: As an eagle that stirreth up her nest, That fluttereth over her young, He spread abroad his wings, he took them, He bare them on his pinions.

12.web: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
12.asv: Jehovah alone did lead him, And there was no foreign god with him.

13.web: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
13.asv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, And he did eat the increase of the field; And he made him to suck honey out of the rock, And oil out of the flinty rock;

14.web: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
14.asv: Butter of the herd, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs, And rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the finest of the wheat; And of the blood of the grape thou drankest wine.

15.web: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
15.asv: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: Thou art waxed fat, thou art grown thick, thou art become sleek; Then he forsook God who made him, And lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

16.web: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
16.asv: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods; With abominations provoked they him to anger.

17.web: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
17.asv: They sacrificed unto demons, which were no God, To gods that they knew not, To newgodsthat came up of late, Which your fathers dreaded not.

18.web: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
18.asv: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, And hast forgotten God that gave thee birth.

19.web: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
19.asv: And Jehovah sawit, and abhorred them, Because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

20.web: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
20.asv: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: For they are a very perverse generation, Children in whom is no faithfulness.

21.web: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
21.asv: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; They have provoked me to anger with their vanities: And I will move them to jealousy with those that are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

22.web: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
22.asv: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, And burneth unto the lowest Sheol, And devoureth the earth with its increase, And setteth on fire the foundations of the mountains.

23.web: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
23.asv: I will heap evils upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them:

24.web: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
24.asv: They shall bewasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat And bitter destruction; And the teeth of beasts will I send upon them, With the poison of crawling things of the dust.

25.web: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror; on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
25.asv: Without shall the sword bereave, And in the chambers terror; It shall destroyboth young man and virgin, The suckling with the man of gray hairs.

26.web: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
26.asv: I said, I would scatter them afar, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men;

27.web: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted, Yahweh has not done all this.’”
27.asv: Were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should judge amiss, Lest they should say, Our hand is exalted, And Jehovah hath not done all this.

28.web: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
28.asv: For they are a nation void of counsel, And there is no understanding in them.

29.web: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
29.asv: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, That they would consider their latter end!

30.web: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?
30.asv: How should one chase a thousand, And two put ten thousand to flight, Except their Rock had sold them, And Jehovah had delivered them up?

31.web: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
31.asv: For their rock is not as our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.

32.web: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
32.asv: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, And of the fields of Gomorrah: Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter:

33.web: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
33.asv: Their wine is the poison of serpents, And the cruel venom of asps.

34.web: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
34.asv: Is not this laid up in store with me, Sealed up among my treasures?

35.web: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides; for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
35.asv: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, At the time when their foot shall slide: For the day of their calamity is at hand, And the things that are to come upon them shall make haste.

36.web: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
36.asv: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself for his servants; When he seeth that their power is gone, And there is noneremaining, shut up or left at large.

37.web: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge;
37.asv: And he will say, Where are their gods, The rock in which they took refuge;

38.web: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
38.asv: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, Anddrank the wine of their drink-offering? Let them rise up and help you, Let them be your protection.

39.web: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
39.asv: See now that I, even I, am he, And there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal; And there is none that can deliver out of my hand.

40.web: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
40.asv: For I lift up my hand to heaven, And say, As I live for ever,

41.web: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
41.asv: If I whet my glittering sword, And my hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine adversaries, And will recompense them that hate me.

42.web: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
42.asv: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, And my sword shall devour flesh; With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the head of the leaders of the enemy.

43.web: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
43.asv: Rejoice, O ye nations, withhis people: For he will avenge the blood of his servants, And will render vengeance to his adversaries, And will make expiation for his land, for his people.

44.web: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
44.asv: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

45.web: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
45.asv: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel;

46.web: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you this day, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
46.asv: and he said unto them, Set your heart unto all the words which I testify unto you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, even all the words of this law.

47.web: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
47.asv: For it is no vain thing for you; because it is your life, and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over the Jordan to possess it.

48.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
48.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

49.web: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
49.asv: Get thee up into this mountain of Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession;

50.web: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
50.asv: and die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

51.web: because you trespassed against me in the midst of the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness in the midst of the children of Israel.
51.asv: because ye trespassed against me in the midst of the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

52.web: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
52.asv: For thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither into the land which I give the children of Israel.
